profile_text.body:
Rackspace Technology is a public company, traded as RXT, founded in 1998 and headquartered in San Antonio. It describes itself as a cloud computing services pioneer that delivers multicloud solutions across apps, data, and security, and says it has helped customers move from hosting to cloud to enterprise AI.

On its own site the company positions itself as an operator of the full enterprise AI stack, from governed private cloud to AI inference and agents in production. It says it assembles and integrates partners across every layer of the stack into a governed system built for enterprise AI in regulated environments, and that security, compliance, data sovereignty, and uptime are foundational to the enterprise AI clouds it operates. It says its engineers embed in customer environments to build, deploy, and run AI workloads in production, and it cites customers in Financial Services, Healthcare, and Government. The site quotes Dr. Zafar Chaudry, MD, Senior VP, Chief Digital Officer and Chief AI and Information Officer at Seattle Children's Hospital.

The record holds no tracked products, no lawsuits, and no MCP servers for the company. Its SEC Central Index Key is 0001810019.
